== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The [[Asphodel]] [[Incarnation]] is a powerful entity that serves as the physical embodiment of its [[Territory]]'s essence and strength. Functioning much like a fundamental force of nature, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] seeks to transform the world into a setting similar to [[Valinhall]]—a place defined by constant combat and harshness where everything must be earned through battle. This entity is characterized by a lack of personal emotion; instead, it sustains itself by feeding on the feelings of others. In combat or interaction, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] can manipulate internal information by nudging it into a tangible form. Visually, the entity has been described wearing clothing made of flower petals and boots crafted from flowing wood decorated with vines. It possesses the ability to manifest large, thick vines and massive flowers that can emerge from the ground to provide seating or consume individuals. Despite its significant power, [[Incarnation|the Incarnation]] has demonstrated a detached and nonchalant demeanor, even appearing unharmed after sustaining a fatal blow to the neck.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|When [[Leah]] and her [[Travelers]] first arrived, the [[Asphodel]] [[Incarnation]] was not present. This entity possesses silver hair, lavender eyes, and wears a mist-cape along with wooden boots decorated by flowers. [[Indirial]] perceives this figure as the worst of all the [[Incarnations]] encountered. The entity is later seen lounging upon a chair constructed of petals.}}
